stories.title: Nvidia shares fall about 4% as company begins probe into CEO’s alleged spy‑linked affair
stories.summary: Nvidia’s stock slipped roughly 4% by the close of trade on Monday after the company announced an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, who is alleged to have ties to Chinese intelligence. U.S. officials have suggested the affair could be part of a Chinese espionage effort, a claim that China’s foreign ministry has called “entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China.”
stories.why: The investigation creates governance and national‑security concerns that may affect investor confidence and the company’s valuation.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
stories.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab released a new AI model on Monday called Muse Ember, the lab’s lightest and most cost-efficient AI model yet. Given the emphasis on low cost and accuracy at scale, Ember is designed to pair with a larger model like Meta’s Muse Wonder in an agentic harness.
